Great question! Our return and refund policy is:

Unused merchandise purchased on our website is eligible for a full refund within 30 days of receipt. Purchases made between October 27 and January 4 have a 60-day return window.
Items must be unused, in original condition, with tags attached.
Final Sale items aren’t eligible for return, refund, or exchange.
We reserve the right to approve returns and may refuse requests that don’t meet policy requirements.
Start a return through the order status/returns page using your order number, email address, and billing ZIP code, or log into your account and select the order. The order must be received first.
After processing, refunds go to the original payment method. Refunds generally take up to 14 days after receipt; allow 5–10 business days after warehouse processing, and banks may take 1–2 billing cycles. We don’t refund shipping charges.
Store purchases must be handled through the original store.
We don’t currently offer exchanges, but you can return the item for a refund and place a new replacement order.

Return labels are emailed after starting the return and are also available on the order status page!
